perche: Z-C21.2-ter, finding N26, measured REAL by the Z-C21.3 probe of the mirrored instance's axes on 28/9/2026. specchia_componente, asked for an instance of the same file, never set IMirrorComponentFeatureData.ComponentOrientationsAlignToComponentOrigin and checked only the centre of the new instance's box. The probe mirrored a 20 x 40 x 10 bracket with a corner boss, inserted at x = +40, on the assembly Right plane, once per swMirrorComponentOrientation2_e value: four DIFFERENT axis sets from Transform2 -- 0 X'(-1,0,0) Y'(0,1,0) Z'(0,0,-1); 1 X'(1,0,0) Y'(0,1,0) Z'(0,0,1); 2 X'(-1,0,0) Y'(0,-1,0) Z'(0,0,1); 3 X'(1,0,0) Y'(0,-1,0) Z'(0,0,-1) -- and the bridge's centre check PASSED on all four (0 mm): it cannot see the orientation. With no array SOLIDWORKS used 0, the default of ComponentOrientationsAlignToComponentOrigin.html («missing orientations default to swOrientation_MirroredX_MirroredY»). The fix sets the orientation (argument «orientation», default mirrored_x_mirrored_y) and checks the axes of Transform2 against it.
il_difetto_che_questo_caso_prende: An orientation asked and not applied (the old library ignores «orientation» and always gives the default: the instance of step 1 has its origin at y = 5 instead of 15); an instance born turned another way that the centre check lets through; axes read from the wrong row of the transform; the refusal of «orientation» on an opposite-hand file going silent.
se_resta_verde_sulla_libreria_vecchia: It does not: on 0.141.0 step 1 reads the origin of the new instance in the state at [-40, 5, 30] (the default orientation) instead of [-40, 15, 30], a real mismatch on a field the old state already reports. Steps 2 and 3 are the same rule on the other two planes. The probe measured the Right plane only; the rule used there (X' = plus or minus the component's X mirrored in the plane, Y' the same with Y, Z' = X' x Y') speaks of the component's axes and not of the plane, so it is applied to Top and Front too. If step 2 or 3 goes red AFTER the fix, that extrapolation is wrong and the check must be corrected before it refuses good mirrors.
i_numeri: Bracket 20 x 40 x 10 extruded upwards from the Top plane, centred in x and z: its box centre is 5 mm above its origin (as in inserire_non_e_accoppiare, where a 4 mm lid has its origin 2 mm below the centre). Inserted with its box centre at (40, 10, 30), so its origin is at (40, 5, 30). A mirror keeps the box centre on the mirror image of the original's centre in every orientation; the origin is that centre minus 5 times the new Y axis. Step 1, Right plane, orientation 3: centre (-40, 10, 30), Y' = (0,-1,0), origin (-40, 15, 30); with the default orientation Y' = (0,1,0) and the origin would be (-40, 5, 30). Step 2, Top plane, orientation 2: X mirrored in XZ stays (1,0,0), Y mirrored is (0,-1,0) and flipped is (0,1,0), Z' = (0,0,1); centre (40, -10, 30), origin (40, -15, 30) (the default would give Y' (0,-1,0) and origin (40, -5, 30)). Step 3, Front plane, default: X and Y lie in the XY plane and stay as they are, Z' = (0,0,1); centre (40, 10, -30), origin (40, 5, -30).

attese.perche_questa_tolleranza: the origin is written rounded to the thousandth of a mm; the true value is exact on these flat blocks
attese.perche: the new instance (the third component by name) turned with Y' = (0,-1,0): its origin goes 5 mm ABOVE the mirrored centre. The old library ignores the orientation and leaves it 5 mm below, at y = 5
the centre is the same in every orientation (probe: 0 mm on all four): it is not what tells them apart

attese.perche_questa_tolleranza: the probe read exact 0 and 1 from Transform2; the answer is rounded to 6 decimals
attese.perche: probe, orientation 3 on the Right plane: X' (1,0,0)
probe, orientation 3: Z' (0,0,-1), so the instance is rigid (X' x Y' = Z')
the second instance (fourth by name) with Y' = (0,1,0): origin 5 mm BELOW the mirrored centre at y = -10; the default orientation would leave it at y = -5
on the Top plane (XZ) y changes sign
X lies in the XZ plane: mirrored it stays (1,0,0), and orientation 2 does not flip it
Y mirrored in XZ is (0,-1,0), and orientation 2 flips it back to (0,1,0)
without «orientation» the default is set explicitly, the one SOLIDWORKS documents and the probe measured with no array
the third instance (fifth by name), Y' = (0,1,0): origin 5 mm below the mirrored centre
X and Y lie in the Front plane (XY): mirrored, they stay as they are

il_messaggio_contiene: applies only to a mirrored instance
